India plans for data center power load amid AI growth

India is planning for a data center power load of 26.3 GW, a strategy reshaped by the growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Anant Raj plans a ₹25,000 crore investment in data centers without seeking fresh funding, distinguishing itself from other companies in India's data center market that are raising debt or equity for similar projects.
